yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No month, day, or year is independently spoken. Using the YAML opening morning of May 19, 1749 conditionally dates the played pre-rest flashback to May 18.
yamlCheck.explanation: The played night-to-morning sequence establishes one overnight, with subsequent play ending at sunset. A whole-covered-adventure start includes that earlier flashback; an opening-scene boundary convention retains the registered May 19–19 endpoints. The preserved timeline files acknowledge the May 18 flashback while choosing May 19 endpoints, but do not authorize a human decision here. This unresolved start-boundary convention prevents an exact match and does not contradict every reasonable reading. The closing proposal to sleep at u10246 establishes no additional overnight.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The pre-rest flashback is actually played, but the registered date range and timeline sidecars use the opening-morning boundary. Keep both conventions open for human review.

alternatives.reading: Whole covered adventure: include the earlier played night; May 18 is conditional on the YAML opening morning being May 19.
Opening-scene convention: retain May 19 as the session boundary, with the previous-night material explicitly marked as a flashback.
